titleFormatted.en: Add state monitor for [[device]], capability [[capability]], label when true [[true_label]], label when false [[false_label]], continuity [[continuity_minutes]] min, min. confirmation [[min_confirmation_seconds]] s, name [[name]]

hint.en: For a boolean capability with no meaningful numeric threshold — a door, a presence sensor, an on/off switch. Tracks time spent in BOTH states — no need to guess which raw value (true/false) means what, just name them. Not for power monitoring — use "Add activity monitor" for that.
Only boolean capabilities on this device are shown (contact, motion, on/off, etc.).

What the raw value true means for this device — check its current value against its current physical state if unsure. Used only for display, doesn't affect what gets tracked (both states are always tracked).
A brief return to false doesn't end a true-session until it holds for this long — the session's end is still backdated to the moment it actually changed. 0 disables this (ends immediately).
Ignores brief flickers that don't hold for at least this long, in both directions. Useful for a flaky sensor. 0 disables this.
